API ReferenceZIdentity APIGroupsGroups Ops Add User
Groups Ops Add User
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/groups/:id/users/:userId

Adds a specific user to an existing group using the group ID and the user ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the group to which the user needs to be added.

userId
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the user being added to the group.

Responses
​
200
400

The request was successful, and the user has been added to the group

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
string
string
